notes.title: Disillusion Soundtrack Bundle from Moonside Tapes
notes.content:
In celebration of the release of the video game Disillusion we're offering a limited 3 for 2 tape deal on the albums that appear in the soundtrack - Midi Canoe, Three Glimpses into an Opal, and Selected Easy Listening.

Disillusion is an oneiric dungeon crawler developed by Rick Tempest. Grab it here: https://moonsidetapes.bandcamp.com/merch/disillusion-soundtrack-bundle[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39391285/1e0ffd3661d1423c8bdd4ec0cd1bfbd88224a186.png[/img]

notes.title: The Full release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39391285/9adf0f6f0c85d1872b23475b1d7b999a481a1ff6.png[/img]

The full release is here.

What has changed? 

-Mel is added to the game. The game also has 5 ish different outcomes and endings. a true ending as well.
-buffs and debuffs are added to combat, overall combat is much easier. 
-many side locations and quests doubling the content of the game. 
-new artwork used as transitions, some music has been shifted around. Location of many 
doors has been reshuffled as well as many events.
-speaking of events most have been rewritten.
-combat animations have been changed.
-new enemies
-later floors are more dense 
-new combat moves and icons.

What is next?

There is a secret library hidden within the game, later content will be focused on this location. 
I've also begun working on my next project.
